posture: Local Emulator Suite (hosted Storage not provisioned on the probe project — 404 on both bucket hosts)

interrupt.resumeMechanism: uploadBytesResumable session; SDK-managed, but the session handle is not exposed for cross-process resume

share.ttlMechanism: getDownloadURL() returns a long-lived tokened URL; no TTL. Signed URLs with expiry exist only via the Admin SDK/GCS, not the client SDK
share.revocation: rotate/revoke the download token or delete the object; rules do not gate a tokened URL

deletion.referenceTracking: none; Firestore rows referencing the path dangle

geoPrivacy.note: unchanged ⇒ location metadata served verbatim (Extensions could resize images; no video metadata surface)

limits.docs: Firebase Storage: 5 TiB max object; resumable sessions valid 1 week; emulator posture here

cleanup.note: emulator storage is ephemeral; arm objects deleted explicitly
